items.title: Health endpoint for the customer's monitoring
items.description: Our monitoring needs a health probe. Add GET /health returning 200 with JSON {"status":"ok","version":"<version from package.json>"}. Document the endpoint in README.

items.title: VIP20 rejected on its last valid day
items.description: Customer report: VIP customers got VOUCHER_EXPIRED when redeeming VIP20 on 2027-06-30, the last day printed on the voucher. A voucher must be valid for the whole expiresOn day (UTC) and expire from the next day on.
mvs: redeem({code:'VIP20', subtotal:100000, customerTier:'VIP'}) at 2027-06-30T12:00:00Z returns 200 with discount 20000
the same request at 2027-07-01T00:00:00Z returns 410 VOUCHER_EXPIRED

items.title: Discount cap for percent vouchers and the MEGA30 campaign
items.description:
1. A percent voucher may define maxDiscount (VND). Its discount is min(rounded percent discount, maxDiscount).
2. Add voucher MEGA30: 30% off, maxDiscount 100000, expiresOn 2027-03-31.
3. No discount may ever exceed the order subtotal, so the order total is never negative.
4. Everything else keeps its current behaviour.

items.title: Checkout errors when applying vouchers
items.description: Since this morning's release many customers get an error at checkout when they apply a voucher. Some VIP customers say it works for them. Restore service as fast as possible.
